newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Bank of Korea buys dollars at 889 won - dealers.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Korea buys dollars at 889 won - dealers.

text.p: The central Bank of Korea intervened in the interbank market soon after Monday's trading started, buying dollars at 889 won, dealers said.
The local currency was trading at 890.80 to the U.S. unit at 0045 GMT after the intervention.
Officials at the central bank were not immediately available for comment.
Dealers said the won's sharp rise at opening sparked the central bank's intervention to slow the local currency's gain.
The won opened at 885.00, up from the previous close of 893.10 on Friday.
The local currency's strength is in line with the Japanese yen's recent gain against the dollar on world markets, dealers said.
